body: Flag: SEVERE. After the 2005 Ambani split Anil took telecom (RCom), power, infra, financial services (Reliance Capital, Reliance Home Finance, Reliance Commercial Finance) -- then a ~$40bn+ market-cap group. Over 2008-2020 it destroyed most of that value: debt-funded expansion, near-100% promoter pledges, insolvency of RCom (2019), Reliance Capital (RBI-supersession 2021, sold to IndusInd International/Hinduja 2024-25), Reliance Naval, and RHFL (resolution 2022). Regulator findings: SEBI (Aug-2024) banned Anil Ambani and 24 entities for 5 years and fined him Rs 25 cr for diverting RHFL funds via 'general purpose corporate loans' to promoter-linked shells (order dated 22-Aug-2024; total penalties ~Rs 624 cr on 27 parties; appeal status not verified). SBI classified RCom/Anil Ambani accounts as 'fraud' (Jun-2025); CBI registered a case on an alleged Rs 2,929 cr SBI loss (Aug-2025); ED opened PMLA cases, arrested the Reliance Power CFO (Oct-2025) over an alleged Rs 68 cr fake bank guarantee to SECI, arrested aides Amitabh Jhunjhunwala and Amit Bapna (Apr-2026) and says it has attached ~Rs 17,000 cr of assets in an alleged Rs 40,000 cr laundering case -- these are agency allegations, not court findings; a further CBI FIR (Apr-2026) alleges Rs 3,750 cr loss to LIC. NCLT admitted SBI's personal-insolvency plea against him as guarantor. Anil Ambani denies wrongdoing; he had not been arrested per reports found. Status Nov-2026: Reliance Power and Reliance Infra remain listed and have raised fresh equity via preferential allotments to promoter/investors -- treat any revival narrative with extreme caution.

data.lesson: group-wide promoter leverage + ICDs = minority wipe-out
data.red_flags: ICDs to shells (SEBI finding 2024); 'fraud' tags by banks; near-total pledges; repeated insolvencies; fake BG allegation
data.status_2026: ED/CBI probes active; aides arrested Apr-2026; personal insolvency admitted
